notes.title: Update and Announcement
notes.notes:
[p][b]Update and Announcement[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone, Over the past few weeks, we've released several small patches addressing minor bugs, improving performance, and expanding localization support.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b] -Optimized chapter 3 and its loading transition -Minor texture optimizations -Implemented a potential fix for keybinds not saving (we believe the issue is resolved, but we’ll continue monitoring for any reports) [/p][p]
[b]New Languages Added:[/b] [/p][p]-Chinese[/p][p]-German [/p][p]-Polish [/p][p]-Ukrainian [/p][p]-Russian [/p][p]-Hungarian [/p][p]-Korean [/p][p]-Japanese [/p][p]-Portuguese [/p][p]-French [/p][p]-Italian[/p][p][/p][p][b]Announcement:[/b] We’re incredibly grateful for the positive reception and would like to thank everyone who has supported the project! As we’ve said before, we’re not done with Necro yet. We’re excited to announce that development has begun on brand-new content in the form of a DLC, which is expected to release later this year. [/p][p][/p][p][b]DLC INFO[/b][/p][p]We're excited to share that a new DLC is in the works  and this time, things are taking a darker turn.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: Necrophosis Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Necrophosis Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-Fixed a camera bug that could occur when exiting the "Worm Trypophobia Puzzle" in Chapter 2.

[b]-Fixed the "Oppressive Intellect" achievement[/b]. The spine lore items were not being counted properly. 
Progress is still saved, but players would need to re-interact with all four spines to unlock the achievement. Apologies to those affected.
(Special thanks to ¨Aergis¨ from our Discord server for reporting the issue.)

[b]-Level Streaming adjustments[/b]
Slightly tweaked the underground level streaming to reduce load times when transitioning into chapter 3.
This should help ease the loading into the level, particularly on lower-end systems.

[b]-Added a new Video Setting[/b]
A new "Texture Memory Budget" option is now available in the Video Settings menu
This setting is intended for players experiencing crashes or GPU-related issues. Lowering it to "Medium" or "Low" may improve stability at the cost of visual fidelity.
If you haven’t encountered any problems, leave this option at the default "Auto" setting.

-A few more minor collision fixes and tweaks.

-Fixed an issue where the center image in the "Choose Waking Cycle" menu would not update when navigating with a controller.


New Localization:
[b]-Greek added[/b]

(More language updates are on the way, so stay tuned for additional localization patches in the coming days.)


Thank you all for your support during the release!
We’re really happy with how the game has been received and can’t wait to share what’s next, we’re not done with Necro just yet! 
(More info coming in a few weeks.)

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hotfix Patch Notes

-Fixed a few minor collision issues in Chapters 3 and 4.

-Implemented a temporary fix for the known blurry vision bug at the beginning of Chapter 3. Since we haven’t been able to consistently reproduce the issue, this fix is experimental, we will look into it again if necessary.
If the bug still occurs, restarting the game should resolve it. 


Thank you all for your support so far! More information on upcoming updates and localization will be shared in the coming days, so stay tuned.
